enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping through the night with the air conditioner on low
enriched_activities.desc: Lies in bed. Closes eyes. Sleeps. Turns onto left side. Pulls blanket. Bends knees. Turns onto back. Adjusts pillow. Extends legs. Turns onto right side. Tucks hand under pillow. Pulls blanket down. Turns onto stomach. Turns head. Sleeps. Wakes at 06:30.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and getting dressed for work
enriched_activities.desc: Opens eyes. Sits up. Stands up. Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on tap. Washes face with soap and water. Rinses face and turns off tap. Dries face with towel. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Spits. Puts toothbrush down. Walks to bedroom. Opens wardrobe. Takes out uniform. Puts on uniform. Puts on socks and shoes.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast with toast and coffee, filling a water bottle for the hot day
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to kitchen. Turns on kitchen light. Opens refrigerator. Takes out bread. Closes refrigerator. Takes out toaster. Puts bread in toaster. Presses toaster lever. Takes out coffee mug. Boils water. Makes coffee. Places toast on plate. Sits at table with breakfast. Eats toast. Drinks coffee. Clears dishes. Takes out water bottle. Fills water bottle. Closes water bottle. Puts water bottle on counter.

enriched_activities.activity: Packing work bag, checking uniform and applying sunscreen before the heatwave commute
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Opens wardrobe. Takes out work bag. Opens work bag. Stands in front of mirror. Adjusts uniform and checks name badge. Takes out sunscreen. Opens sunscreen bottle. Applies sunscreen to face. Applies sunscreen to arms. Applies sunscreen to neck. Closes sunscreen bottle. Puts sunscreen in bag. Places water bottle in bag. Checks phone. Places keys in bag. Zips bag. Picks up bag. Walks to door.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital during the morning heat (public transport)
enriched_activities.desc: Picks up work bag. Walks to front door. Opens front door. Walks out. Closes front door. Locks front door. Walks to bus stop. Stands at bus stop. Checks phone. Bus arrives. Boards bus. Taps transit card. Walks to seat. Sits down. Looks out window. Checks phone. Bus stops. Stands up. Walks to bus door. Exits bus. Walks to hospital. Enters hospital. Walks to physiotherapy department.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a hospital physiotherapist: assessing patients, running rehabilitation sessions and writing clinical notes
enriched_activities.desc: Arrives at physiotherapy department. Reviews patient schedule. Walks to patient room. Greets patient and reviews chart. Asks patient about pain and observes movement. Palpates patient's knee. Demonstrates and assists with exercise. Records notes on computer. Washes hands. Walks to next patient. Runs rehabilitation session. Instructs patient on exercises. Monitors patient's progress. Writes clinical notes. Takes lunch break. Eats lunch. Returns to work. Attends team meeting. Updates patient records. Ends shift.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home from the hospital in the late afternoon heat (public transport)
enriched_activities.desc: Leaves physiotherapy department. Walks to hospital exit. Exits hospital. Walks to bus stop. Stands at bus stop. Checks phone. Bus arrives. Boards bus. Taps transit card. Walks to seat. Sits down. Looks out window. Checks phone. Bus stops. Stands up. Exits bus. Walks to home. Enters building. Walks to apartment door. Unlocks door. Enters apartment.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a cool shower to recover from the hot commute
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bathroom. Turns on bathroom light. Turns on shower. Adjusts water temperature. Steps into shower. Wets body. Picks up soap. Rubs soap on body. Rinses body. Picks up shampoo. Applies shampoo to hair. Rinses hair. Turns off shower. Steps out of shower. Picks up towel. Dries body. Dries hair. Puts towel in hamper. Puts on clean clothes. Walks out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking a simple dinner and eating it while listening to music
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out ingredients. Takes out cutting board. Chops vegetables. Turns on stove. Places pan on stove. Adds oil. Adds vegetables. Turns off stove. Takes out plate. Serves food onto plate. Walks to table. Sits down. Turns on music. Eats dinner. Stands up. Clears dishes. Rinses plate. Puts plate in dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa with the air conditioner on, watching TV and streaming a show
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to living room. Turns on air conditioner. Sits on sofa. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Navigates to streaming app. Selects show. Plays show. Watches TV. Stands up. Walks to kitchen. Gets snack. Returns to sofa. Sits down. Resumes show. Watches TV. Turns off TV. Stands up. Turns off air conditioner. Walks out of living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Loading and running the washing machine, tidying up the bathroom
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bathroom. Turns on bathroom light. Opens washing machine. Loads dirty clothes. Adds detergent. Closes washing machine. Sets cycle. Starts washing machine. Wipes sink. Wipes counter. Wipes mirror. Picks up items from floor. Puts items in cabinet. Sweeps floor. Empties trash. Turns off light. Walks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Reviewing patient notes and reading professional physiotherapy material on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to study. Turns on desk lamp. Sits on chair. Turns on computer. Opens patient notes file. Reads notes. Types notes. Scrolls through notes. Opens browser. Searches for physiotherapy articles. Reads article. Highlights text. Takes notes. Closes browser. Closes patient notes. Turns off computer. Turns off desk lamp. Walks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting ready for bed and sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Turns on bedroom light. Takes off clothes. Puts on pajamas. Walks to bathroom. Washes face. Brushes teeth. Walks to bedroom. Turns off bedroom light. Turns on air conditioner. Pulls back blanket. Lies down on bed. Adjusts pillow. Closes eyes. Sleeps. Turns onto side. Pulls blanket up. Breathes slowly. Remains still. Sleeps.
